value.rationale: A sharp necessary-and-sufficient threshold based on one integrated resident return statistic predicts whether more competitively superior propagules initially reduce habitat occupancy; it excludes any second reversal for arbitrary finite reversible resident communities. The explicit two-state example produces a strict 25% relative loss in total patch occupancy at intermediate invasion pressure. This addresses a natural ecological counterintuitive question, not a parameter-grid exercise. The ecological interpretation is conditional on clearly stated idealized dynamics.
